Her clothing is taken directly from <Picture 1>: a red sheer open hanfu robe with floral embroidery worn open over a pink lotus-embroidered 肚兜 (underbust top), plus a matching flowing red skirt.
<Subject 2> is the older master Can Niang (蚕娘) in <Picture 2>, with long silver-white braided hair, a gentle smiling face, and bare feet, wearing a cream-and-gold layered hanfu with a gold-embroidered bodice.
<Subject 3> is the pond-side garden environment in <Picture 3>, featuring a calm ancient-Chinese pond with water lilies, flat stone banks, pagodas and pavilions in the background, autumn trees with golden-red leaves, hanging lanterns, and soft late-afternoon light filtering through mist.
<Subject 4> is the vertical 9:16 cinematic style of the video: warm late-afternoon garden light, wet-fabric transparency and cling, water splash and droplet effects, clean skin, hard cuts only, no subtitles, no on-screen text.
<Subject 5> is the simple bamboo fishing rod held by <Subject 2>, a thin tapering pole with a light line and a small red-and-white float, with no separate reference image.
<Subject 6> is the enormous fish on the end of <Subject 5>'s line: a big dark-olive carp as long as an adult's torso, with a thick humped back, broad bronze scales, wide fins and a powerful thrashing tail, with no separate reference image.
<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1), from the audio file <Audio 1>. The spoken voice should follow the timbre and natural delivery feeling of <Audio 1> as closely as possible; do not add extra rasp or artificial traits not present in the sample.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] The target video is a 25-second vertical comedy short set at <Subject 3>. <Subject 2> hooks <Subject 6>, a fish far too big for <Subject 5>, and is dragged into a tug-of-war; <Subject 1> leaps into the pond and clamps the fish in a bear hug; <Subject 2> heaves on the rod, and the taut line reels both girl and fish up out of the water along one continuous arc that climbs, tops out over the open pond, and carries <Subject 1> back down toward the bank; at the top of that arc <Subject 6> twists free and plummets straight back into the pond while <Subject 1> keeps falling along the same arc and drops into <Subject 2>'s waiting arms, where <Subject 2> has already flung the rod aside to free both hands and catches her in a princess carry, soaked and draped in pondweed. This entire flight—from the heave on the rod, through the rise along the arc, the fish breaking free at the apex and falling back into the pond, to <Subject 1> continuing along the same arc and landing in her master's arms—is staged as one continuous unbroken shot with no cut anywhere in the middle of the flight. <Subject 2> then teases her and scrapes her cheek, and the video ends on her soft laugh as she holds <Subject 1> in the embrace. Character appearances come from <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>, the environment from <Picture 3>; these are appearance and environment sources only and are not frame anchors. Wordless action beats are played as medium two-shots with both women in frame; the one spoken line is cut to a dedicated single-speaker close-up with the other character kept out of frame. <Subject 2> (S2) delivers the teasing line in [Shot 6]. <Audio 1> gives <Subject 1>'s voice feeling; <Audio 2> gives <Subject 2>'s voice feeling.

detailed_description:
The target video is a vertical 9:16 live-action cinematic comedy short in a warm ancient-Chinese garden, with soft late-afternoon light, gentle haze, wet-fabric transparency and cling, water splash and droplet effects, clean skin, hard cuts only, and no subtitles or on-screen text. The airborne flight in [Shot 5] is staged as one continuous unbroken shot: the camera follows the action from the heave on the rod, through the rise along the arc, the fish breaking free at the apex and plummeting back into the pond, all the way to <Subject 1> continuing along the same arc and dropping into <Subject 2>'s arms, with no cut anywhere in that sequence.
[Shot 1] A medium shot frames <Subject 2>, Can Niang, seated cross-legged on a flat stone at the edge of <Subject 3>, holding <Subject 5>, the bamboo fishing rod, in both hands; the line drops to a small float resting motionless on the calm pond. Behind her the pagodas, autumn trees with golden-red leaves and hanging lanterns stand in soft haze. <Subject 1>, Honghua, crouches on the same stone a little behind and to her master's right, chin propped on one hand, watching the float with idle impatience. Neither woman speaks. The camera holds a static shot as the float gives one small twitch.
[Shot 2] the shot cuts to a medium two-shot: the float is yanked clean under the surface and the bamboo rod of <Subject 5> bows into a deep arc. Can Niang plants her bare feet on the stone, rises into a half-crouch and leans back with her arms straining as something enormous surges beneath the water; the line hisses across the surface and a heavy swirl boils up five paces out. Honghua scrambles upright beside her on the stone, eyes going wide, hands half-raised. Neither character speaks; only the creak of the rod and the churn of water.
[Shot 3] the shot cuts to a medium two-shot of the stone bank: Can Niang braces one bare foot against the stone edge, the rod held high in both hands, her whole body tilted back against the pull, sleeves sliding down her forearms. Honghua takes two short running steps along the bank, pushes off the stone edge and drops into the shallows in a compact jump with her knees drawn up, her red robe and red skirt flaring out behind her; she hits the water and vanishes under a white splash. Can Niang never looks away from the line. No one speaks.
[Shot 4] the shot cuts to a medium shot at the water's surface: Honghua breaks the surface waist-deep, soaked hair plastered to her cheeks, and throws both arms around <Subject 6>, the big dark-olive carp as long as her torso, clamping it against her chest in a tight bear hug. The carp thrashes, its powerful tail hammering the surface into foam and soaking her again and again; she locks her hands together over its back and strains with a wordless cry of effort, a non-speech vocalization matching <Audio 1> (S1), with no intelligible line. Can Niang is visible at the bank behind her, still hauling on the bent rod.
[Shot 5] the shot cuts to a medium two-shot that takes in the flat stone bank on the left and the open water on the right, and then holds as one continuous unbroken shot: Can Niang braces her bare foot against the stone and gives one tremendous heave, straightening her back and swinging the bamboo rod of <Subject 5> up and back over her shoulder. The line snaps taut and <Subject 6>, the big carp, is torn clean out of the water with Honghua still locked around it, so the girl and the fish leave the surface as one and begin to climb. Because the line runs back to Can Niang at the bank, the pair do not fly away from her but rise along a single clean diagonal arc that carries them up and over the open water and back toward the bank where she stands. Water sheets off them in a curtain; Honghua's red skirt flares and the carp's bronze scales flash in the late-afternoon light, its tail still beating against her side. The camera tilts up with large amplitude at fast speed and continues in an arc shot, keeping the climbing pair centred in frame the whole way, and follows them all the way to the top of the trajectory, high above the pond, where the pair are still locked together with the water far below. At the apex, <Subject 6> gives a violent twist, thrashes out of Honghua's arms and plummets straight down behind her, the line going slack, and hits the pond with a heavy slap that throws up a tall column of water. Honghua's arms stay curved around empty air for a beat, and her body keeps travelling along the very same arc—over the apex and down toward the bank—her soaked skirt and hair streaming upward past her as she falls. Still in the same unbroken shot, the camera tracks down with her and reveals Can Niang at the water's edge: she flings the bamboo rod of <Subject 5> down onto the flat stone behind her, freeing both hands, turns to face the water and takes two quick steps into the shallows with her arms held open and her knees bent to receive the weight. Honghua drops into her; Can Niang takes the impact, folds her knees to absorb it, swings one arm under Honghua's knees and the other behind her back, and settles her into a princess carry. Honghua is drenched from head to foot, her soaked red robe and pink 肚兜 clinging to her skin, her long black hair strung with wet strands of green pondweed hanging over her temple and caught in the red floral hairpins. Can Niang's own cream-and-gold hanfu is splashed dark and clinging at the shoulders and bodice. Water runs off both of them in thin streams. No one speaks in this shot.
[Shot 6] the shot cuts to a dedicated close-up of the speaker <Subject 2> (S2): Can Niang alone fills the frame from the chest up, still holding Honghua in the princess carry, with Honghua deliberately kept below the frame edge so that no other character can take the line. Can Niang looks down past the lens with her smile widening and says in a warm teasing voice matching <Audio 2> (S2), <d>[Chinese] 我道是什么鱼这般势沉，原是条美人鱼啊。</d> Still smiling, she lifts her free hand and draws the side of her index finger in one slow teasing scrape down the curve of Honghua's cheek, then laughs under her breath, a soft 呵呵, a non-speech vocalization matching <Audio 2> (S2). Honghua does not speak in this shot. The video ends on Can Niang's soft laugh and the two of them held in the embrace.

overall_soundscape:
Calm pond ambience with gentle water lapping, distant insects and a faint breeze through the trees in [Shot 1]. A sudden heavy surge and the creak of straining bamboo as the rod bows in [Shot 2]. Two quick running steps and a compact splash as she drops into the shallows in [Shot 3]. Violent thrashing and foaming water in [Shot 4], over which Honghua strains with a wordless cry of effort, a non-speech vocalization matching <Audio 1> (S1). In [Shot 5], one continuous bed of sound covers the whole unbroken flight: a drawn-out rushing whoosh with a curtain of falling water as the pair are reeled up out of the pond along the arc, the carp's tail still thrashing against Honghua, then a heavy carp-body slap and a tall column of water as the fish plummets back in at the apex, over which the same airborne rush continues as Honghua keeps falling, followed by two quick wading steps and the wet impact of a body caught in open arms. Wet fabric, close dripping and a soft low laugh in [Shot 6], and the video ends on that laugh. No background music.
